METHODOLOGY: Every elimination run sourced from CompuLink timing data via DragRaceCentral.com "Summary of Eliminations" reports. Reaction times measured to the .001. Fouls (negative RT) and DQs (no valid timing) are excluded from leaderboard averages but included in best/worst counts. "% BEST IN ROUND" = pair- or quad-best reaction time across all rounds the driver competed in.
